map.title: Skill map
map.subject: By subject
map.searchFocus: Centre the map on a skill…
map.focusHelp: Above: what comes before. Below: what it opens. Tap a skill to move the focus.
map.subjectHelp: Arrows point from a skill to the ones it opens. Tap a skill to focus on it.
map.tooMany: Showing the {{shown}} closest to the current age out of {{total}}.
map.wholeHelp: {{done}} of {{total}} skills achieved (bright dots). Tap a dot to open it in focus.

progress.title: Progress
progress.expectedNow: expected on average at this age
progress.curveHelp: Cumulative number of milestones reached by each age, compared with a typical child (dashed) and the usual range (shaded band, about the 10th to 90th percentile).
progress.curveNote: Based on {{dated}} dated milestones; the line stops at the last one logged. The band is approximate: milestones are not independent, so the real range is wider.
progress.devHelp: The age at which a typical child has reached as many milestones in that subject. Actual age: {{age}}.
progress.devNote: Counts achieved and probably-achieved milestones. “≥” means all the milestones we track in that subject are achieved, so the real value is higher and unknown.
progress.goalsHelp: Share of learning goals (school-type skills) starting at or before the current age that are achieved. Never a verdict: these depend on teaching.

alerts.title: To discuss
alerts.explain: These milestones are past the age by which 90% of children have them, or a skill was lost. This is not a diagnosis: children vary a lot. Mention them at the next check-up; a lost skill is worth mentioning soon.

checkin.title: Quick check-in
checkin.help: Tick what she can do today. Earlier skills that are required first are then counted as probably achieved.
checkin.none: Nothing to check in this subject around this age.

about.title: About & credits
about.intro: A private family app to follow a child's skills against scientifically sourced reference ages, and to suggest what to work on next.
about.notMedical: This is not a medical or diagnostic tool. Children vary a lot; when in doubt, talk to your pediatrician.
about.marble: The {{count}} school-age skills and their prerequisite links (ages 4 to 13) come from the Marble Skill Taxonomy, an open dataset made by our friends at Marble. Thank you!
about.ownCatalog: The {{count}} early-development skills (birth to 6 years) were compiled from:
about.estimates: Where a source gives a single age (e.g. CDC's 75th percentile), the other percentiles are estimated and marked as such.
about.mit: The app code and our own catalogue are under the MIT licence. Marble's data keeps its own licences (ODbL 1.0 and CC BY-SA 4.0).
